propositions: Close operation unconditionally invokes the completion provider verifier even when a valid cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation already exists at the resolved target SHA

The close precheck and auto-resume seams do not consult the ticket's existing signed completion op-cert before dispatching to the provider, despite the signature infrastructure already authenticating the record and exposing its SHA and material fields

A same-ref close with an eligible attested PASS must reuse that certification and make zero provider calls while falling through to fresh verification for any ineligible, stale, malformed, changed-ref, reopened, or non-PASS record
The reuse check must validate that the authenticated verified-at-sha equals the resolved close target ref and the authenticated material fingerprint matches the ticket's current material fingerprint
